breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly specified both Dirichlet and Periodic boundary conditions. The ground truth removed the contradictory periodic condition. The agent correctly identified this conflict and generated a specification that only includes the Dirichlet conditions ('Boundary conditions are Dirichlet, with u(0,t)=0 and u(1,t)=0.'), which matches the ground truth.
